question: In which of the following cities the 2023 SAFF Championship was held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2) Bengaluru**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2023 SAFF Championship** was held in **Bengaluru**, India.
 
• **India**, the defending champions, won their** ninth championship** by defeating Kuwait in the final.
 
• The SAFF Championship is a football competition of the men's national teams governed by the South Asian Football Federation.
 
• **Bengaluru** is known for its vibrant sports culture and has hosted various national and international sporting events.
 
• The tournament featured teams from South Asia competing for the championship title.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The SAFF Championship is held biennially and is the premier football tournament for the South Asian region.
 
• Bengaluru, also known as the Silicon Valley of India, is the capital city of the Indian state of Karnataka.
 
• The city has a rich history in sports and is home to various sports academies and training facilities.
 
• Hosting the SAFF Championship in Bengaluru has helped in promoting football and sports tourism in the region.
